oneSentenceStory: The customer reviews her 5,600 LBG coins translated directly into pounds sterling to assess redemption options at her own pace.
customerSituation: Customer has accumulated 5,600 LBG coins across 3 connected brands and wants to understand their exact cash equivalent before deciding how to use them.
storyTension: Reward point abstractions and ambiguous conversion rates risk confusion and cart abandonment.
customerResolution: Clear, transparent monetary valuation and partner comparison options empower informed, pressure-free decision-making.
primaryOutcome: Clarity of tangible monetary value and informed autonomy in reward choices.
completionSignals: customer interacts with partner comparison tool
